selection_rationale: Broad reproducible research panel of published disease, physical and quantitative trait models. Most use the same penalized-regression portability study (Wang et al., AJHG 2022, PMID 34995502) to make model provenance and population limitations consistent; dedicated published HCM/DCM scores are included. Models are not ranked as best clinical predictors. Sex-, age- and disease-context applicability is not established from genotype alone.
interpretation: Raw uncalibrated research scores. European training and evaluation in other populations do not establish calibration for an individual or an admixed population. Partial scores are explicitly distinguished. No risk probabilities, phenotype units, percentiles or high/low labels are inferred.
